infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera permission is required to capture site environment rig photos, specimen sample cards, and physical field log sheets.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access is needed to select saved field photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Precise GPS location is required to geotag borehole investigation depths and sample logs.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow TerraLog to record device GPS coordinates for borehole strata logs.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow TerraLog to access your camera to photograph drilling rigs, sample tag cards, and log sheets.
